editorial.description_en: A sand-finished wall in a room with one window — light, warm, and flat.
editorial.description_ja: 砂を混ぜた壁のような、明るくあたたかい色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.866, C 0.040, h 70.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 砂 (suna, sand) + 壁 (kabe, wall). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Sand Wall" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 砂壁. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — shira-tsuchi at ΔE00 4.6, kawaki-suna at ΔE00 4.9, furu-gami at ΔE00 5.7. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (250°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
